description: Pakistan Oxygen Limited supplies industrial, medical and specialty gases, and says it has served the development of Pakistan's industrial gases industry for more than 70 years. It counts more than 4,000 customers across chemicals and petrochemicals, steel, food and healthcare, and runs 24-hour operations at ten major industrial locations in the country. Alongside gases it supplies gas-handling equipment and welding hardgoods.
headOffice: P.O. Box 4845, Dockyard Road, West Wharf, Karachi 74000, Pakistan
